name: Sun Cleric Calm is refused on a silence-immune enemy (owner ruling O-6)
contract: Owner ruling O-6 (2026-11-21): Calm 804057 is refused as a whole on a silence-immune target. The tooltip reads
"Enemies that are immune to silence effects cannot be affected by this." Spell.dbc 804057 carries the disarm
auras 67 and 254 with EffectMechanic 3 (DISARM); only its trigger 807778 carries Mechanic 9 (SILENCE), so
before the fix the disarm landed on a silence-immune enemy. The Sun Cleric cast check now answers
SPELL_FAILED_IMMUNE (38) when the target holds a native SILENCE mechanic immunity. Two Undead targets of the
same level: Brittlebones Skeleton 201 (creature_immunities -93, fear and horror only) is the control and is
disarmed and pacified; Bloodmage Thalnos 4543 (creature_immunities -273, SILENCE in its MechanicsMask) is made
silence immune by its creature template immunity, proved by the native effect-immunity query against
807778 effect 0 (MOD_PACIFY, mechanic SILENCE), and refuses the whole cast: no disarm, no pacify. Both casters
carry spell hit rating so a miss cannot leave an aura absent.
